pollster.weighting_quote: The information was based on known registration and participation statistics by gender and age. An additional measure interacted participation by race, as reported by the state, with the education attainment of each racial group as reported by the American Community Survey. Another interaction measure captured the 2024 presidential votes within the designated market area to account for the differential turnout of voters in each area of the state.
